props.name: aria-label
props.description: The accessible name for a slider with no `label`. A range joins it to each thumb's name.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the field's root.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The value on mount, for an uncontrolled slider. An array of two or more numbers renders one thumb per entry, and a one-number array is read as that number. The slider reads it on mount and again on a native form reset, as React reads its own inputs' defaults.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text, rendered as `Field.Description`.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error text, rendered as `Field.Error` when truthy. While it is falsy, the field shows its own validation error instead.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Number format options for the value `showValue` shows and the value a screen reader announces for each thumb. The locale comes from the provider.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the slider, so the thumb shows the disabled face.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid, so the thumb shows the invalid face.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, rendered as `Field.Label`. It names the thumb of a single-value slider.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: The step for PageUp, PageDown and Shift with an arrow key.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: The highest value.

props.name: minValue
props.description: The lowest value.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name the value submits under.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new value on every change while a thumb moves. A range reports an array of the same length as `value`. A native form reset does not call it.

props.name: onValueCommitted
props.description: Called with the final value when the user finishes a change. It fires once when a thumb drag or a track press ends, if the press moved the value at any point, even when the value ends where it started. It also fires on each key press that changes the value. A range reports the same shape as `onChange`. It does not fire while a thumb drags, or for a press that never moved the value. Save or fetch from here rather than from `onChange`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: The slider's axis. A vertical slider fills its parent's height below the label row, so give the parent a height. Its control keeps at least 160px.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the formatted value at the end of the label row. A range joins its values with an en dash.

props.name: step
props.description: The step for the arrow keys and the snap grid, counted from `minValue`.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names of a range's thumbs, by index. Defaults to the locale dictionary's minimum and maximum, joined to `label` or `aria-label`. A single thumb takes its name from `label` or `aria-label` instead.

props.name: value
props.description: The value, for a controlled slider. `Value` is a `number`, or an array of at least two numbers, one per thumb, for a range. A one-number array from untyped code is read as that number, so `onChange` reports a number. `undefined`, passed or omitted, makes the slider uncontrolled, as with React's own inputs. A slider suits known bounds where a rough position is enough. For an exact number, give a NumberField the same value beside it.
